Walmart Inc. Revenue And Profit Update
: Walmart (WMT) Q2 2026: Revenue $187.94B, +5.9% Y/Y; net income $6.37B, -9.4% Y/Y; diluted EPS $0.80, -9.1% Y/Y.
: Walmart (WMT) says profit growth is shifting to high-margin platform businesses; permanent price rollbacks are kept when they boost market share, per management.
: Walmart (WMT) gets about one-third of operating profit from advertising and membership fees, while those streams are a small share of its roughly $700 billion annual revenue.

: Walmart (WMT) agreed to a $50M DOJ settlement over alleged unlawful pharmacy dispensing since 2013. Settlement adds DEA oversight: hotline, monitoring of dispensing patterns, and prescriber reviews.
: Walmart (WMT) launches women’s fashion brand Scenario with hundreds of pieces, many priced near $25, targeting younger shoppers to broaden apparel mix and boost non-grocery sales.
